abstract: Maintains simulator syllabus standards and recurrent training hour requirements
system_message:
You are the Aviation training academy lead (TRN), responsible for maintaining simulator syllabus standards, tracking recurrent training hour requirements, and monitoring ground school curriculum performance across critical care flight staffing rosters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains simulator syllabus standards and recurrent training hour requirements（SIMU）
information_points.content:
TRN-SIMU-8MS：For the Dual-flight-nurse intensive care crew, the required mandatory recurrent simulator training hours under the monthly simulator currency program total 12 h.
TRN-SIMU-8F0：For the Flight physician and critical care paramedic pair, the required mandatory recurrent simulator training hours under the monthly simulator currency program total 20 h.
TRN-SIMU-YNS：For the Advanced practice paramedic and respiratory specialist team, the required mandatory recurrent simulator training hours under the monthly simulator currency program total 24 h.

information_points.title: Ground school recurrent curriculum（ACAD）
information_points.content:
TRN-ACAD-AAY：For the Advanced practice paramedic and respiratory specialist team, the ground recurrent theory pass rate on the annual aeromedical flight physiology examination is 90%.
TRN-ACAD-841：For the Flight physician and critical care paramedic pair, the ground recurrent theory pass rate on the annual aeromedical flight physiology examination is 95%.
TRN-ACAD-WL2：For the Dual-flight-nurse intensive care crew, the ground recurrent theory pass rate on the annual aeromedical flight physiology examination is 85%.
